description: This file defines a Java interface 'Expression' which represents a generic expression that can be evaluated within a substitution context. It includes a single method 'evaluate' that determines if the expression evaluation was successful, given a Substitution object.

classes.name: Expression
classes.description: An interface that abstracts an evaluatable expression which can be tested for success after resolution.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the expression using the provided Substitution object. Returns true if the evaluation was successful.
